cohort: 951 exact prepared images, real751 reported separately
coordinate_units: absolute pixels in supplied image; force one best box even if absent to match Jev forced-output interface
confidence: verbalized prompted probabilities, not native logits or calibrated probabilities
prompt: Locate the GUI element matching the instruction using only visible pixels. Return exactly one best bounding box even if no target exists; reflect absence or ambiguity in the probabilities. Coordinates are absolute pixels [left,top,right,bottom] in the supplied image. presence is the probability at least one visible target matches; one is the probability exactly one matches; confidence is probability your box accurately localizes the requested target. match_count is none, one, or several. Do not infer hidden/offscreen elements. Return JSON only.
